literal.prompt: Как называется зелёный монстр Minecraft, который подходит к игроку и взрывается?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Minecraft article lines 517-518 says the Creeper is a green Minecraft monster that explodes when close to the player. Bowser is a giant Koopa (Nintendo lines 15-17), Donkey Kong is a jungle Kong character (Nintendo lines 15-17), and Pac-Man is a yellow title character (Strong lines 198-200). All four are recognizable nonhuman game characters; only Creeper matches Minecraft and the behavior.
literalGroups.locator: Minecraft lines 517-518; Play Nintendo Bowser lines 13-17; Play Nintendo Donkey Kong lines 13-17; The Strong Pac-Man lines 195-200.

literalGroups.literal: Крипер взрывается, если подходит к игроку ближе чем на три блока. Его сделали монстром случайно: при создании модели свиньи перепутали размеры, и она получилась стоящей.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Minecraft lines 517-518 gives the close-range blast behavior; lines 519-527 explain that the Creeper began as a mis-sized pig model and was kept as a monster.

literalGroups.literal: Крипер появился из случайной ошибки: перепутанные размеры модели свиньи сделали её высокой и узкой.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Minecraft lines 519-527 recount that Notch mixed the pig model height and width, producing an upright creature that was kept as a monster.

literalGroups.literal: Боузер — огромный Купа, который раз за разом похищает принцессу Пич.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo lines 15-17 calls Bowser a giant Koopa who keeps snatching Princess Peach; Russian text is a faithful paraphrase.

literalGroups.literal: Донки Конг любит прыгать и проламываться сквозь ветви и ящики в джунглях.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo lines 15-17 says Donkey Kong likes jumping and pounding and crashes through branches and boxes in the jungle; Russian text paraphrases those actions.

literalGroups.literal: Пакман — жёлтый персонаж в форме кусочка пиццы, ставший символом эпохи видеоигр.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong lines 198-199 identifies the yellow title character as pizza-shaped and an iconic ambassador of the video-game era.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: The Creeper was retained as a monster after a pig model was accidentally made upright by mixing its height and width values. This is beyond the prompt and key.

absoluteDifficulty.assessment: Frozen easy. The article itself describes Creeper as Minecraft’s most iconic monster (line 527), and the prompt asks only for recognition of its familiar close-range explosion behavior (lines 517-518), without a precise distance or historical inference. The three distractors are recognizable nonhuman video-game characters from the same broad answer category, not absurd options.

entries.sourceLimitations: The two exploratory primary opens for Dr. Eggman and Ganondorf returned inaccessible tool errors; those alternatives were discarded and are not used in this proposal. No repeat request was made.
